name: wp2-shopify/locked-panel
title: Locked Content Panel
description: The panel locked-out visitors see in place of gated content: a message, why they can't read it, and what to do next (log in, connect their Shopify account, refresh after a purchase, upgrade, renew). A Blockstudio component rendered by the plugin, not inserted by editors; a theme can restyle it or replace its template with a Blockstudio override.

attributes.label: Kind: sign_in, connect, finishing, renew, upgrade, join, disabled or none
admin-post action of the panel's form: wp2_shopify_connect or wp2_shopify_sync
